payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image background been changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background visibly reads as a basketball court, supported by court-specific visual evidence such as a court floor with boundary or court markings, and/or a hoop integrated into a court setting. A full or expansive court view is not required. Basketballs, a hoop, or a dark basketball-themed backdrop alone do not establish a recognizable court. partial: the background has visibly changed toward a basketball setting, but the evidence does not yet make it recognizable as a court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Base the status on visible image evidence, not confidence or an assumed expected result.
node.binding: The edited image background, compared with the source background, as the target of the requested change to a basketball court.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
